inputs.text: This flare-up between the US, Israel, and Iran is sending oil prices soaring and squeezing fuel costs for Indian families. The government's reckless cut to excise duties on petrol and diesel is classic short-sighted meddling that drains national revenue and will only drive worse inflation ahead. Our exposure to foreign crude has left the nation vulnerable to these overseas conflicts, proving we cannot count on global entanglements for security. A strong sovereign nation must reject this dependence and pursue real energy self-reliance to defend our sovereignty. This is the only path that upholds the traditional principles of prudence, personal responsibility, and family security at the core of any stable society. Continuing to lean on unstable foreign powers will erode our economic order and put the futures of our families at risk.

output.main_topic: Oil-price and fuel-cost effects of the US-Israel-Iran flare-up and advocacy for Indian energy self-reliance
